job.job_description:
Job Summary




We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer with expertise in High-Performance Computing (HPC), Apache Spark, Databricks, and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML solutions, optimize large-scale data processing pipelines, and build innovative GenAI applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI/ML solutions for large-scale enterprise applications.
Build and optimize distributed data processing pipelines using Apache Spark and Databricks.
Develop and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Claude, and Mistral.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks and vector databases.
Utilize High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments to accelerate AI model training and inference.
Fine-tune foundation models and optimize model performance for production workloads.
Develop scalable data engineering and MLOps pipelines.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Business Stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize AI applications in production environments.



Required SkillsAI & Generative AI

Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
LangChain, LlamaIndex
Fine-tuning and Model Evaluation
AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems



Data Engineering & Big Data

Apache Spark (PySpark)
Databricks
Delta Lake
Data Modeling and ETL/ELT Pipelines
SQL and NoSQL Databases

Python
SQL
REST APIs



High-Performance Computing

Distributed Computing
Parallel Processing
GPU Computing (NVIDIA CUDA preferred)

CI/CD Pipelines
